verdict.rationale: Skyvern has a dedicated CAPTCHA and bot-bypass docs page. It states that its vision model detects CAPTCHAs and solves them automatically, and it names supported types: reCAPTCHA v2/v3, hCaptcha, Turnstile, FunCaptcha/Arkose, MTCaptcha and image CAPTCHAs. That is an explicit documented stance. Separately, browser sessions offer human-in-the-loop pauses and VNC takeover, a plausible manual route, but nothing documents it as a CAPTCHA fallback, so it only weakly supports that part of the story. Missing for 10: documented behavior when CAPTCHA solving fails (error surfacing or escalation rather than silent failure), a CAPTCHA-specific human fallback, independent or hands-on corroboration of solve reliability.
